g.text: Webflow, petite-vue + UIkit, PWA, Tauri and Dioxus: one component, four builds
Designers keep Webflow. 11ty and Beautiful Soup turn its HTML into components; Cloudflare serves them with no compile step. Rust nests in only where it earns its build.
Shared source: one design, parsed once
No compile: vanilla on the edge
no bundler, no npm in the page
Data from Xano, the system of record
Tauri: Rust nested under the page
the page calls the Rust core
dx serve: hot reload while editing
the same webview stack as Tauri
Revenue endpoint: Google Merchant API + Vertex AI audience, server-side, after consent. Every build writes to Xano; none calls Google from the page
read first; one key per change
by locale; not English by default
Conversions return to BigQuery, keyed by the same idempotency key, so revenue is counted once per market
Rust core only; the page stays vanilla
Everything: Rust to WASM and native
Designers; Rust devs own the commands
Rust devs; designers hand off the map
On the device, in the Tauri core
In the UI, and in #[server] functions
Updater files and installers from R2
Server-side from Xano, never the page
Same; offline orders queue, then sync
Same; the Rust core posts to Xano
Rule: start vanilla and add a build only for a reach the browser lacks. A PWA for offline, Tauri for the device, Dioxus when the whole UI should be Rust. The component map keeps all four in step.
